notes: One logical opposite-direction XAU/XAG monthly momentum-vote basket. The EA compares synchronized arithmetic-average completed monthly returns at the locked one-, three-, and twelve-month horizons, buys the metal winning at least two ranks, shorts the other, and evaluates combined package PnL and costs at Q02.
The logical basket must never be decomposed into standalone XAU or XAG gate results. One RISK_FIXED budget is split equally by per-leg ATR stop risk.
